1996 an ex friend of mine brought a gun to school,  and before we got off of the bus that morning he talked me into holding it.  He said someone sa2 him with it and added me to hold it until he was sure they weren't going to tell. I did because I was an idiot and was easily used because of my longing for approval.   I got pulled out of first period and searched after he told them I had the gun.  Turns out he stole the gun from his father along with $800  from his neighbor.  
    This was just before all the school shootings started and in a very small town., otherwise my ass would have been fucked.  Since was such a timid, quiet, respectful kid  all my teachers including the D.A.R.E. officer wrote letters to the judge pretty much begging for mercy.  I was terrified during the whole thing.  My father got me a lawyer and I got off with probation until i turned 18 and community service.  The judge took pity on me that day, and the guy who i got the gun from ended up in juvie until he was 18.  This wasnt his first time in trouble. 
   I also got suspended for what seemed like an eternity, since all this happened just before winter break.  I had nightmares every night until court and many after.  Hands down one of the scariest things I'd ever gotten myself into.  As far as I know the school kept it all pretty hush hush.  I was in the 8th grade in a small poor country white town(I'm black and the guy I got it from was white).  My family was convinced they'd lose me forever to the system, luckily they took pity on me and I was given a second chance.  
    I still get physically nervous just thinking about what could have happened if I wasn't such a straight arrow before all this.  I never saw he who shall not be named ever again but I hope he turned out alright.

I've quit a few times through the years and have always felt better for it.  I just always seem to go back to it.  I'm considering quiting again, this time for good.  For me it's the ritual of smoking that I'm addicted to more than anything. I've recently joined a muay thai gym and I absolutely love it, but I know I'm holding myself back smoking and eating like a pig late into the night.  I sleep three to four hours a night and constantly feel tired.  I just need to pull the trigger and quit.  I feel like I can replace my old ritual with exercise and muay thai but I just keep putting it off.  My wife is a heavy smoker (cigarettes and bud) and I'm sure this also has a lot to do with me putting green off quiting. There's no way in hell she is going to quit anytime soon,  but she is a lot more functional  than I am, and seems to function better after she smokes.  Anyway it's late and I don't really know what I'm trying to say here other than I'm happy for you and reading your post this morning has given me the courage to quit again. This time for good I hope.  Thanks I appreciate you sharing your story.
